title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 49 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 49)

content.overview: Section 49 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter I, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.
content.glance: Section 49 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter I, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.
content.study:
Section 49 — Enforcement of foreign awards

Section 49 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter I, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.

The Part II analysis must begin with the statutory definition and the Convention framework, then identify the exact condition or enforcement ground engaged. The statutory grounds should not be expanded by general merits review.
